Removes GTA 6 videos, Shorts and comments from YouTube before you see them.

## Download

- **Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi** (any Chromium browser): `sixbegone-…-chrome.zip`
- **Firefox 128 or newer**: `sixbegone-…-firefox.zip`

Install steps are in the [README](https://github.com/onni-min/SixBeGone#install).

> Unofficial. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
